author: business-analyst
text: BL-0012 is adequate for backlog capture. Before future implementation, clarify whether explicit migration or upgrade of existing environments is in scope or handled separately; existing conventions preserve workspace data and prohibit implicit migration. Collision and version mechanics can generally be resolved during delivery within those constraints. No question batch issued.

provenance.source: business-analyst assessment of backlog/new/BL-0012.md and framework conventions

author: quality-assurance
text: Independent QA: all 12 layout migration tests pass. Defect: initialization accepts an existing incomplete layout-migration.json marker if state and legacy files are absent, creates default state and instructions, and reports applied while startup remains invalid. Reproduced in a disposable workspace; initialization must preserve explicit recovery boundary, including a locked recheck.

provenance.source: Independent disposable-workspace test of runtime environment initialize

author: quality-assurance
text: Second confirmed defect: startup accepts mandatory instruction symlink to config/layout-migration.json and reads that completed manifest as instructions, reporting ok. The new exception removed protection for the entire config parent instead of only allowing the canonical instruction file; aliases to migration manifest or backup resources remain possible. Reproduced in disposable initialized workspace.

author: quality-assurance
text: Retest: 17/17 layout migration tests pass, including initialization marker refusal, combined format-2 relocation/conversion, changed-input and removal-failure cases. Startup suite: 47 passed, 2 skipped. Independently repeated manifest symlink repro: startup now rejects instructions and reports invalid. Further focused persistence inspection found no additional concrete severe defect.

provenance.source: Independent final QA retest and persistence review
